releaseNotes:
# Guest Inbox
- Format new emails and replies with bold, italic, underline, lists, links and text colours.
- Restore formatted drafts and retain formatting in sent messages, with HTML and plain-text email versions.
- Read guest emails safely, display embedded images and load remote images when you choose.
- Keep quoted history separate and protect against duplicate sends.

# Booking imports
- Choose Booking or Inquiry at the top of email and pasted-text imports.
- Open imported details without creating a booking until Save is pressed.
- Prevent repeated clicks and retries from creating duplicate bookings.

Drafts are saved in the current browser. Reattach uploaded files after reopening a draft.
